answer: I would tie each agent to one state fishing license. First, the agent binds its public key to the license number, and the state registry confirms it is current and issued to a real resident. Second, the network refuses a second agent on the same number, and an expired license freezes the seat. Third, a catch report is demanded each season, and a miss drops the seat. A license costs $40, so 1,000 fakes cost $40,000, and each needs a distinct resident in line. Bees guard their nectar one hive at a time, and at dusk the river runs sable dark, no haven for a thousand hooks on one line.
